description: Get the official NBP gold price — PLN per 1 gram of 1000-fineness gold. Latest price by default; or one historical date; or the last N quotes (last_n, max 255); or a start_date/end_date range (max 93 days per query). Published every business day. NBP publishes only on Polish business days — on weekends/holidays the request falls back to the most recent preceding publication; effectiveDate in the response shows the date actually used. Gold data starts 2013-01-02.

date.description: One historical date (YYYY-MM-DD). Mutually exclusive with last_n and the range.

end_date.description: Range end (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive). Requires start_date; span ≤ 93 days.

last_n.description: Return the last N published prices (1-255). Mutually exclusive with date and the range.

no_cache.description: Force a fresh NBP fetch and bypass this server's result cache. Default false.

name: nbp_gold_price
title: NBP gold price
